paragraphs.text: Microsoft technology is deeply embedded across the Gulf. Banks, government suppliers, healthcare groups, contractors and trading companies widely use Microsoft 365, Active Directory, SQL Server and Azure. Microsoft stack development GCC organisations commission fits naturally into that environment, with single sign-on, familiar tools and strong vendor support. Staff already know the tools, and IT teams can manage security from one place.

Offshore .NET development for GCC organisations adds a stable, in-house team at Kerala rates, with a working day that overlaps yours. You keep full ownership of code, databases and cloud accounts, and you see progress at the end of every two-week sprint. There are no local hiring, visa or office costs, and the team does not change halfway through your project.

items.title: ASP.NET Core Development for the UAE and Gulf
items.text: ASP.NET Core development UAE organisations order from us covers web applications, customer and staff systems, approval workflows and APIs. We plan screens, roles and data first, then build in two-week sprints with a demo at the end of each. Single sign-on with your existing Microsoft accounts means staff do not need another password.

items.title: .NET Framework Migration for GCC Companies
items.text: Many Gulf systems still run on the older, Windows-only .NET Framework. Our .NET Framework migration for GCC companies moves them to modern .NET in planned stages, testing every module in a staging copy so staff keep working throughout. Modern .NET runs on Linux as well as Windows, which can lower hosting and licence costs after migration.

items.title: SQL Server Systems for GCC Enterprises
items.text: SQL Server systems for GCC enterprises include database design, performance tuning, reporting, high availability and backup planning. We also clean up and document older databases that have grown without structure over many years. Slow reports that once took minutes can often be brought down to seconds through indexing and query tuning.

items.title: Microsoft Azure for GCC .NET Apps
items.text: Microsoft Azure for GCC .NET apps lets you host applications and data in Gulf regions, including Azure's UAE and Qatar regions, for speed and data residency. We set up app services, databases, identity, monitoring and automated deployments, with cost alerts so cloud spend never surprises your finance team.

items.title: .NET ZATCA E-Invoicing Integration
items.text: .NET ZATCA e-invoicing integration connects your .NET system to Saudi Arabia's FATOORA platform, run by the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority. We generate compliant invoice formats, QR codes and cryptographic stamps, and handle the reporting and clearance steps your business must follow. Invoice records are stored securely and can be searched and exported for audits.

sections.h2: Gulf Data Protection, Tax and Hosting

paragraphs.text: Gulf countries apply their own data protection laws, including the UAE's Personal Data Protection Law, Saudi Arabia's Personal Data Protection Law and Qatar's Personal Data Privacy Protection Law. Our .NET systems use role-based access, encryption, audit logs and Gulf cloud hosting where data residency is required.

Tax rules also differ: the UAE and Oman charge VAT at 5%, Saudi Arabia at 15% and Bahrain at 10%, while Qatar and Kuwait do not currently apply VAT. One .NET system can apply the right rules for each country or entity.

As a dot NET development company GCC enterprises use for core operations, we commonly build procurement and approval workflows, contract and project management tools for contractors, HR and staff self-service systems, finance and invoicing applications, and reporting portals that combine data from several SQL Server databases. Most projects begin with one module and grow in planned phases, which spreads cost across budget cycles and proves value early.

sections.h2: .NET Development Cost in UAE and the Gulf

paragraphs.text: .NET development cost in UAE projects depends on modules, user roles, integrations, tax and compliance needs, and whether existing code must be migrated. How much does a .NET developer cost in Dubai? Local senior developers command high salaries, which is why many Gulf organisations work with an experienced offshore team. Every Teknoppy project is quoted after discovery, with a fixed price for the agreed scope.

items.q: Can you work with our internal IT team and Microsoft licences?
items.a: Yes. We work within your existing Microsoft 365, Azure and SQL Server environment, follow your security policies and can join your internal teams' sprints.

items.q: What hours do you work for Gulf clients?
items.a: Our day starts early in India, covering most of the Gulf working morning. Meetings and releases are scheduled inside your office hours, and we plan around the different weekends in the UAE and the rest of the GCC.

items.q: Can one .NET system serve several Gulf countries?
items.a: Yes. Languages, currencies, tax rules, approval chains and data access can be set per country, entity or branch within one application.

items.q: Do we own the code and data?
items.a: Yes. All code, databases, cloud accounts and documentation remain yours throughout.

items.q: How do I choose a dot NET development company GCC organisations can trust?
items.a: Confirm the engineers are in-house, ask for references, check how e-invoicing, Arabic and data residency are handled, and insist on a fixed written scope.
